title: Advance a state distribution repeatedly
description: You store successive probability vectors and compare later steps.
source: draft: codex free model + edit: codex

steps.description: You put all initial probability in the first state. traj allocates enough rows to hold the initial vector and 30 updates.

steps.question: Which vector produces traj[k] on each iteration?
steps.answer: The previous row multiplies P on the right. Each update advances the distribution by one transition.

steps.description: You store every updated vector and plot one probability curve per state. The legend uses the existing state names.
You compare the printed vectors at steps 10 and 30. They are close.
